# Agenda and notes

Record the agenda items in order. For each item, note the discussion
and any decision reached. Write the minutes in the past tense, and
keep each item to a short paragraph or a short list.

# Any other business

Note anything raised outside the published agenda.

# Date of next meeting

State the date, time and location of the next meeting here.

:::
